notes.title: new character
notes.content:
new character, a samurai from the bloody-eyed clan named [Ryumei] 
to release Ryumei you need to finish the game on the Hard level, if you have finished the game on this level the Ryumei character will be on the character selection screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/423c9b3648f1f2821e9a0c6f5dce12a2cb1732a0.png[/img]


and a remaster in the game’s protagonist [Karina]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/4ac9f9d2acf2c2b75762a4b6e442281131c399fd.png[/img]

this will be the last update of content related to art because now I will start the development of [Revenge on the streets 2]!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/1a946abdfb7aba4f6796abd69169418516ceb322.png[/img]

notes.title: (Rana) back to the origins and a new character named cristina
notes.content:
(Rana) back to the origins

I redesigned and programmed (Rana) which was initially designed for this game and for those who liked the other character she is still in the game! finish the game once and it will be in the character selection screen


(PT BR)
(Rana) de volta às origens

Redesenhei e programei (Rana) que foi inicialmente projetada para este jogo e para aqueles que gostaram da outra personagem ela ainda está no jogo! termine o jogo uma vez e ele estará na tela de seleção de personagens

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/3eafe493d1a5465b6ac4ba7bccc2994de122aefe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/0bb3f0437b25b923262f2b7313f1d7630fc9cefc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/d27c619b06d74c0e578e1f9be45935be01a5c1d9.jpg[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35209026/1afb583d0b7ae1faa00ba77511674adb8c364ab8.png[/img]

new secret character, if you have finished the game at least once, the character (Cristina ferraz) will already be in the character selection screen!

If you haven't played the hard mode yet, know that you have two unique enemies on this difficulty and if you can finish the game on the last difficulty you will unlock the character (Luana).

(PT  BR)
nova personagem secreta, se você terminou o jogo pelo menos uma vez, a personagem (Cristina ferraz)  já estará na tela de seleção de personagens!

se você ainda não jogou no modo difícil, saiba que tem dois inimigos exclusivos nessa dificuldade e se conseguir terminar o jogo na última dificuldade vai desbloqueia o personagem (Luana).
